target_customer: Retail crypto investors wanting passive diversified exposure
problem: Retail users find it hard to pick and rebalance crypto assets; Hedgehog offers basket-based robo-advice.
business_model: Consumer fintech app (fees on managed crypto baskets, custodial product)

founders.name: Taylor Culbertson
founders.background_notes: Programmer and filmmaker; CEO of Infinite Sum consultancy

exit.reason: Company letter says it could no longer sustain itself and would shut down at the end of the month (date of letter not seen); users pointed to Uphold for a replacement basket product and to Gemini for custody transfers.

competitors.name: Shrimpy
competitors.what: Crypto portfolio app with index and rebalancing tools

technical_complexity.rationale: Portfolio rebalancing plus custody and app-store apps in a crypto setting; standard fintech engineering with regulatory complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Basket crypto products were easy to copy; the SEC exit interview claim hints at regulatory friction rather than a moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sourced incumbent copying; Hedgehog depended on Gemini as custodian from its June 2023 app launch and Uphold took over a basket product on shutdown.

market_need_then: Founders said managing a crypto portfolio amid shifting regulation and tax rules had become a full-time job (company about page). V1 claimed 15k users monitoring $176m in assets but only $548k gross transaction value (own YC profile), which suggests monitoring demand outran paying use.

branding.name_origin: Company about page ties the name to the founding story (managing a crypto portfolio had become a full-time job so they made it theirs, and 'Crypto Hedgehog' was born); it does not say why a hedgehog.

identity.mascot_or_character: Hedgehog animal brand; design rationale not found

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches and branded merchandise (bottle, caps, socks, hoodies) are mentioned in passing; no evidence of broader community.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly, memorable animal name and some merch, but it shares the word with Hedgehog Markets (a Solana prediction platform) and PostHog's hedgehog mascot; no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Hedgehog was a crypto robo-adviser that joined YC in S21, raised a $1.6M seed in August 2021 led by Dragonfly with Baroda Ventures and YC, and launched iOS and Android apps with Gemini as custodian in June 2023 after an SEC registration. It later shut down: its own letter says it could no longer sustain itself and sent users to Uphold and Gemini, but I did not find the date or a fuller cause, so the cause is not public beyond unsustainability and no failure factors are asserted. Reported V1 numbers (15k users watching $176m, $548k GTV) hint at weak monetization. The failure factor is recorded as 'other' because the stated cause (unsustainable operations) fits no more specific taxonomy code.
notes: Searches done: outcome, funding, funding cross-check (CoinDesk Aug 2021 via search summary, CoinDesk June 2023 fetched, company blog 'funding secured', YC page headline), dated competitor, branding. Shutdown letter fetch returned 503, so its wording and the missing date come from a search summary; exit date left null. Directory Inactive agrees with shutdown. Seed $1.6M agrees across CoinDesk and VCBacked; Dealroom shows $5.1M across two seed rounds and CB Insights $130K; those are not recorded. The earlier record's amount was null; now $1.6M. Founded 2019 per directory; the consumer app launched 2023. Shrimpy is the only competitor with a dated source (a 2019 blog, exact date not seen); Bitwise indexes and Coinbase were not sourced. The hedgehog.app site and the CoinDesk 2021 page (SSO redirect) were not worked around.
